messages:
zoe-partner: Starting a compact thread for OrbitCloud marketplace + HW partner + SI joint GTM. Target launch next Tue 10:00 PT. Owners?

felix-product: I'll do manifest + SKU mapping. Need OrbitCloud perf matrix (p99 latency, batch sizes).

tara-marketing: Draft press release and landing live in CMS. Embargo target Tue 10:00 PT. Need partner quote, logo vect, and 2 short customer blurbs.

ishaan-ops: Ops items: autoscale pre-warm for 24h, rate limit policies, healthcheck endpoints enabled. Preflight scheduled Mon 15:00 PT.

marta-legal: Send PR text to me. Avoid superlatives about "unlimited throughput" and confirm asset license for logo.

zoe-partner: OrbitCloud approved logo and provided short quote: "OrbitCloud and Redwood enable consistent LLM throughput on dedicated appliances."

marta-legal: Minor tweak: change "consistent" to "predictable". Otherwise OK. Send signed asset pack.

felix-product: Manifest note: adding fields `max_streams` and `token_cap`. Suggest defaults small/med/large: 1/3/8 streams; 4k/16k/64k tokens.

qa-bot: CI: manifest branch passed schema validation at 2685001200. :white_check_mark:

tara-marketing: UTMs: `?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=orbitcloud_launch_v1`. I'll lock CMS after legal signoff. Also need a 30s explainer video by Mon noon.

ishaan-ops: Can review video for CDN timing if delivered Mon noon. Preflight Mon 15:00 PT (2685003000) noted.

zoe-partner: Final owners list: quote/logo (zoe), legal signoff (marta), assets/video (tara), manifest (felix), ops/runbook (ishaan). If anyone slips, flag here.

felix-product: I'll post manifest diff by Sun EOD.

marta-legal: I'll review PR Sunday night and comment inline.

tara-marketing: Creating #launch-orbitcloud channel for live event.

zoe-partner: Thanks all 44d. This thread is canonical for signoffs.
